actions.title: Backfill required fields by stage
actions.description: Fields marked required at a record's current stage are empty. These need a value entered manually - nothing here can be inferred automatically.

actions.title: Correct flagged field values
actions.description: Values that failed a validity check - out-of-range amounts, failed statutory ID checksums, and similar. Each needs a look before correcting; not safe to bulk-overwrite.

actions.title: Review suspicious creation patterns with the team
actions.description: Unusual creation bursts or off-hours activity. This is a review action, not a data fix - some of these will turn out to be legitimate (a trade show, a bulk import). No point gain is promised here, since resolution depends on what the review finds, not on this app changing anything.

actions.title: Review suspected duplicates
actions.description: These matched on fuzzy signals (name similarity, shared blocking key) below the confirmation threshold. Per the confirmed duplicate policy, nothing here auto-merges - each needs a human look to confirm it's actually the same record before any merge happens.

actions.title: Merge confirmed duplicates
actions.description: Exact match on a strong identifier, or exact match on email and phone together - the only two paths that auto-confirm a duplicate. This app is read-only and cannot merge records itself; this is the list to hand to whoever has write access.
